input_integrity.note: All 18 monthly parquet files per dataset (4 datasets) verified against .sha256 sidecars

data_provenance.label_caveat: ironflow liquidations are a capped-sample feed (not a complete census per RESEARCH_PROMPT.md section 15); absence != zero; claims restricted to presence/intensity ordering

methodological_fixes_applied: ma_dev uses last_close reference quirk (not current-hour close)
Duan smearing residual applies None->1.0 only (not 0.0->1.0)
Liquidation notional accumulation uses sequential Python += in (month, row) order
Train-only mean/std uses sequential Python sum/pstd in coin-major order
Feature logs use scalar math.log(max(v,0)+eps) instead of np.log

primary_findings.verdict_rule: STABLE iff (long arm) sign reproduced in >= 0.80 of blocks AND first/second-half gap CI excludes sign reversal AND ordered-block trend test does not reject stationarity at frozen alpha_k; otherwise NOT_STABLE.
primary_findings.interpretation: The SUPPORTED broad-universe cross-sectional association is time-block dominated (first half vs second half gap CI includes 0), failing RESEARCH_PROMPT.md section 17 promotion condition #4. This is an honest, valid NOT_STABLE outcome.

multiplicity.note: Holm 6-arm family reuses primary bootstrap p for 4 arms; does not affect STABLE/NOT_STABLE verdict

limitations_and_caveats: This is a stability test of a cross-sectional association, NOT a time-series forecast gate
Ironflow liquidations are a capped-sample feed; absence cannot be interpreted as zero liquidations
The association is cross-sectional rank-ordering, not calibrated magnitude improvement
Poisson deviance materiality floor (2%) NOT met on either arm
Short arm mean rank-IC is near zero (-0.002), no evidence of short-arm skill
Regime conditioning (RV-tercile, UTC buckets) is descriptive; primary verdict does not depend on it
Frozen data panel (2025-05..2026-10); no out-of-time evaluation possible
conclusion: The temporal stability of the cross-sectional funding -> next-hour observed liquidation intensity association on the broad 799-coin ironflow_bulk universe (2025-05..2026-10) is NOT_STABLE. The SUPPORTED association from BROAD-01 is time-block dominated and fails RESEARCH_PROMPT.md section 17 condition #4. No forecast gate is passed. No risk overlay is eligible. The null is preserved honestly.
